sourceRefs.locator: ARTEM 4511, Archives nationales AE II 6 (K 2 no. 3). Header, regest and ll. 3–4, naming the king’s parents Dagobert and Nanthild as buried in the basilica. Clichy, 22 June 654.
IV.79, pp. 66–67, including n. 1. Illness at Épinay, Aega, Nanthild, Clovis and burial at Saint-Denis. Wallace-Hadrill follows Courtois in dating the death to 638.

Sections “La basilique et ses deux nécropoles” and “Naissance du monastère”. Building extensions, 1959 discovery of the grave attributed to Arnegunde, more than 200 excavated northern burials, plaster sarcophagi and Dagobert’s patronage.
Introduction to the royal burials and section on the Merovingian basilica. Dagobert’s burial, present-day site and the date 639 used by the institution.

summary.de: Bei dieser Kirche nördlich von Paris liegen mehrere alte Gräberfelder. Der Beisetzungsort Dagoberts I. und Nanthilds ist auch schriftlich bezeugt.
summary.en: Several early burial grounds lie at this church north of Paris. Written sources also identify it as the burial place of Dagobert I and Nanthild.
